notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (Annual and Sustainability Report 2025, IFRS). Interest paid, interest received, dividends received and income taxes paid all sit in operating activities, so nothing is added. Captive-finance growth (leased assets, FS receivables) is inside OCF, as at Volkswagen, so paidOut is inflated by 2,534 € million. Lease principal (135) in financing noted, not added. OCF fell to 3,614 € million from 6,353 largely because profit before tax dropped to 445 € million after the product-strategy realignment charges (depreciation, amortization and impairment of 5,451 € million is added back).
